Rates behind the tables: sales page conversion 1.5% to 3.5% on cold Meta and 4% to 8% on retargeting and the seed list; quiz completion 35% to 60%; review booked 4% to 10% of all buyers; review to proposal 40% to 60%; proposal to won 25% to 35%. The nurture keeps working on the buyers who do not book.
AOV is not margin. Print, packing and AccuTrack shipping on the pack come off the top, and the plan carries a per-unit cost line once the print quote is in.
Further levers if needed: the pack to $300, a second bump (the Five CISO Archetypes package at $20), a shift in mix toward paperback.
One SOC 2 or ISO 27001 engagement per quarter pays for the year. Two makes it your cheapest channel. Read the CPA as cost per qualified conversation, not cost per book.
